results.title: West Bengal STF arrests suspected Pakistani national Wahab Alam alias Rana Rauf
results.description: West Bengal STF apprehended a suspected Pakistani national in North 24 Parganas. The arrested individual, Wahab Alam, allegedly holds links with Pakistan's Inter-Services Intelligence. He reportedly entered India through Nepal in 2012 and lived under forged documents. Another person, Muhammad Izaz, was arrested in East Kolkata for providing these documents. Authorities are currently investigating the connection between the two arrested individuals.

results.title: 'I won't defund the police': Mamdani responds to AOC's stunning reckoning, 'Woke 1 was crazy'
results.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is weighing in on what critics and supporters alike are calling a major 'self-reckoning' on the political left.
